title: Multi-Omics Biomarkers in Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma: Biological Insights and Clinical Translation: A Narrative Review.

title: Cancer-Derived Exosomes: A Cross-Cancer Comparative Analysis of Exosomal Proteins and MicroRNAs.
snippet: Exosomes are small extracellular vesicles that mediate intercellular communication and, in cancer, carry cargo that both reflects the donor tumor cell and influences recipient cells within local and distant microenvironments.
